$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the workspace hibernation settings (plans/cmux-next/workspace-hibernation-DESIGN.md): idle workspaces leave memory. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants (WorkspaceHibernationSettings parses them). Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: hibernation
lists.note: Settings > General > Hibernation. WorkspaceHibernation (CmuxNextApp) reads every row; a workspace's Keep Awake (its row's Options menu) wins.

rows.name: enabled
rows.note: On by default (Lawrence 14151: pause idle workspaces and free their memory). Off: nothing hibernates on its own; Hibernate Workspace still works.

help.text: Frees the memory of workspaces you have not used for a while. Terminals and agents keep running; pages and chats come back where they were when you open the workspace.

rows.name: idleMinutes
rows.note: Minutes since the workspace was last shown, printed output, or its agent spoke. 60: an hour away. Memory pressure shortens it (warning 10 minutes, critical 1).

help.text: A workspace hibernates when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many minutes. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.

rows.name: hiddenSpaceMinutes
rows.note: Minutes a workspace of a space no window shows waits instead (leo-workspace design/spaces.md, Hibernation and the perf plan); the shorter of this and idleMinutes applies. 15: picked from bench_workspace_hibernation.py (the PR names the run). Memory pressure shortens it the same way.

help.text: When no window shows a space, its workspaces hibernate after this many idle minutes instead. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.

rows.name: freeingEnabled
rows.note: Off by default at first (plans/cmux-next/sidebar-recents-and-freeing-DESIGN.md): it ends shell processes, user-visible high-tier behavior. On: a hibernated workspace idle freeingIdleMinutes parks each terminal that sits at an empty prompt (park-tabs); showing it starts a new shell in the same folder under the saved screen.

help.text: Ends the shells of workspaces you have not used for a long time when they sit at an empty prompt. Opening the workspace starts each shell again in the same folder, with its saved screen above it. Running commands, agents, pinned workspaces and workspaces kept awake are never freed.

rows.name: freeingIdleMinutes
rows.note: Minutes since the workspace was last shown, printed output, or its agent spoke. 1440: a day away.

help.text: A hibernated workspace's idle shells end after this many minutes without use (1440 is one day).
